observations.empty_band: 4E88: a blank band roughly 56px tall sits between the message body ('明日の会議...') and the 出所 line, about 4x taller than any other gap in either card (other gaps are ~10-20px). Total image height differs by ~57px between the two (286px vs 229px) and that difference is accounted for almost entirely by this one gap, while every other gap (header spacing, between 宛先/差出人/body lines, and between 出所 and the button row) matches within 1px. It reads as an unintended leftover margin rather than a deliberate spacing decision.
observations.content_lost: none: header '# Slack', title 'このメッセージを送りますか？', '↗ 外部に出る', 宛先 #sales, 差出人 あなた, both body lines, 出所 週次同期・田中・10:42 with chevron, and Cancel/Edit/送る buttons are all present and identical in both images.

why.visual_craft: A15D keeps a consistent, tight rhythm end to end; 4E88's one oversized gap before 出所 reads as an unfinished layout rather than a considered choice.
why.spacing_rhythm: Every gap in A15D is roughly the same order of magnitude (~10-20px); 4E88 has one gap (~56px) that is 3-4x every other gap in either card, breaking the rhythm.
why.information_hierarchy: Same fields, same order, same labels and weights in both images — only the whitespace before 出所 differs, not what is emphasized or grouped.
why.preview_readability: In A15D the message body sits close to its 出所 attribution, so the two read as one connected unit; in 4E88 the large gap visually detaches the source line from the content it describes.
why.provenance_visibility: The 出所 line itself (icon, text, chevron) is rendered identically in both — same size, color, and position relative to the buttons — so its legibility is unaffected by the extra gap above it.
why.control_reachability: The gap between 出所 and the button row, and the buttons themselves, are essentially identical (within 1px) in both images, so reachability is unchanged.
why.overall: A15D delivers the same content with tighter, more consistent spacing; 4E88's unexplained large gap between body and source is the one clear flaw and drags down its overall craft.
